mechanism: Oseltamivir may increase risk of acute kidney injury through viral-mediated renal effects or dehydration, while torsemide-induced diuresis and electrolyte depletion can compound renal dysfunction and increase susceptibility to volume depletion.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and volume status closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider temporary adjustment of torsemide dosing if oseltamivir-treated patient shows signs of renal deterioration.
